home.intro_text: For over 20 years, Igor Vasylkov has been crafting custom furniture of any complexity in Odessa, Ukraine. Each piece is a fusion of classical craftsmanship and contemporary design, tailored to your vision and space.
home.faq_1_q: Where to order custom furniture in Odessa?
home.faq_1_a: Igor Vasylkov is a master craftsman specializing in custom furniture in Odessa, Ukraine. Call +380674864629 or email ive@ukr.net.
home.faq_2_q: What types of furniture do you make?
home.faq_2_a: Kitchens, wardrobes, doors, staircases, tables, restaurant décor, and any custom piece designed to your specifications.
home.faq_3_q: How much does custom furniture cost?
home.faq_3_a: Pricing depends on project complexity and materials. Contact us for a free consultation and estimate.
home.cta_text: Call or message us — free consultation and on-site visit available.

about.title: About the Craftsman
about.subtitle: Igor Vasylkov — Custom Furniture Master
about.body: For over two decades, Igor Vasylkov has dedicated himself to the art of bespoke furniture making. Each project is a dialogue between craftsman and client, where technical perfection meets individual vision. Igor's work can be found in private homes and restaurants across Odessa and Ukraine.
about.craft_text: From the first sketch to final installation — every stage is personally overseen. We use quality materials, proven techniques, and original solutions for each commission.
